Thanks for the context, Marissa. Quick read-through notes: 

- DPA: we can accept a standard DPA but need to align data categories and subprocessors; recommend attaching Redwood's DPA and asking them to mark any deviations. Suggest we provide Redwood_DPA_v2.docx as baseline.
- Deletion/return: we should push back to reasonable retention windows; propose specific language (see redline).
- SLA: 99.9% for dedicated is reasonable operationally but will require a carveout for maintenance windows and force majeure; also need to align remediation (credits) vs. termination rights. Recommend credit schedule rather than termination at first pass.
- PO/billing: we accept PO references on DocuSign; billing contact (finance@redwood.com) will work with their finance team for invoicing and payment terms.

I will produce a controlled redline and a 1-page change summary. Attaching: redline_summary_RI.pdf and Redwood_MSA_v3_redline.docx. Can we target Thu 09:00 PT for the deliverable?
